must_contain: In M3, using the consent artefact ID, the HIU fetches the consent artefact and requests the health information covered under that consent, and the data is delivered to the data push URL provided by the HIU.
The first M3 call is POST /api/hiecm/consent/v3/fetch with the consentId, and the artefact arrives on /api/v3/hiu/consent/on-fetch.
In P3 a PHR app turns a notification that a record exists into the record itself, by raising a consent request, getting it granted, and asking for the health information the grant covers.
notes: Group A, an imperative task phrase that spans M3 and P3: it catches an answer that names neither module, or that starts the M3 route at the health information request instead of the consent fetch.
